component.name: WSnip
component.summary: Capture, mark up and save screenshots

description.p: WSnip is a screenshot tool with the feel of the Windows Snipping Tool. Freeze the screen, pick what to keep, mark it up and share it.

ul.li: Rectangle, window, full screen and freeform snips, with an optional delay
Pen, highlighter, eraser and crop markup
Copy to the clipboard and save as PNG, JPEG, HEIC, AVIF or JPEG XL
HDR snips keep their highlights in gain map images
